scope.reason: Apply reproducible source-plus-bathymetry review to the selected Baja production scope without relying on session calibration.

methodology.direction_convention: Meteorological swell direction: the bearing indicates where swell travels from; rays are traced outward from the break toward that bearing.
methodology.grid_use: GMRT 500 m and NOAA ETOPO 2022 15 arc-second grids are sampled from 4 to 60 km offshore across five bearings spanning each window.
methodology.decision_policy: A source-reported direction becomes medium confidence when at least three of five bearings retain at least 85% ocean coverage in both grids. A fail-closed exception requires an allowlisted refraction override, at least two spot-specific published sources, and a documented terrain rationale. High confidence still requires independent spot-specific published corroboration.
methodology.nearshore_limit: These global/regional grids validate exposure, land shadow, and broad shelf or canyon continuity. They cannot resolve an individual reef ledge, sandbar, takeoff, tide response, or current conditions.
methodology.gmrt_fill_limit: The unmasked GMRT topo layer uses a global bathymetry fill where higher-resolution contributed data are unavailable; ETOPO is therefore used as an independent terrain-model cross-check, not as a field sounding.
methodology.gebco_context: GEBCO_2026 is the current public-domain 15 arc-second global terrain model and provides a TID source-type grid. It is cited as the current global reference but was not substituted for the two computed grids.
